title: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
authors: Letian Fu, Justin Yu, Karim El-Refai, Ethan Kou, Haoru Xue, Huang Huang, Wenli Xiao, Guanzhi Wang, Dantong Niu, Fei-Fei Li, Guanya Shi, Jiajun Wu, Shankar Sastry, Yuke Zhu, Ken Goldberg, Linxi “Jim” Fan

hands.zh: 以夹爪控制为主：核心 Robosuite 单／双臂任务与 LIBERO-PRO；BEHAVIOR 扩展评测使用 R1Pro 移动平台，真机展示包含 Franka Panda 与 AgiBot G1。末端接口以开合夹爪为主；未找到多指灵巧手关节控制评测，不能按机器人平台数推算手型数。
hands.en: Gripper-oriented control in core Robosuite single/bimanual tasks and LIBERO-PRO; extended BEHAVIOR evaluation uses mobile R1Pro, with Franka Panda and AgiBot G1 real-robot demonstrations. Interfaces chiefly expose gripper opening/closing; multi-finger dexterous joint-control evaluation was not found. Robot count is not hand-type count.

tasks.zh: v2 的 CaP-Gym 声称 187 项任务（7 Robosuite＋130 LIBERO-PRO＋50 BEHAVIOR）；主要 CaP-Bench 对照为 7 项：拾块、叠块、擦拭、插销、积木重堆、双臂抬举和交接，比较 12 个模型、S1–S4／M1–M4 八档，每任务每档 100 次。CaP-Agent0 扩展至 30 项 LIBERO-PRO 与 2 项 BEHAVIOR 任务；后者各 25 次。CaP-RL 在拾块／叠块／擦拭三任务分别训练，真机只量化前两项，各 25 次。
tasks.en: V2 reports 187 CaP-Gym tasks: 7 Robosuite, 130 LIBERO-PRO and 50 BEHAVIOR. Core CaP-Bench compares 12 models across eight S1–S4/M1–M4 tiers, with 100 trials per task/tier on cube lift, stack, spill wipe, peg insertion, cube restack, two-arm lift and handover. Agent0 extends evaluation to 30 LIBERO-PRO and two BEHAVIOR tasks, the latter with 25 trials each. CaP-RL trains lift/stack/wipe separately; real-robot quantitative evaluation covers lift/stack with 25 trials each.

cross_hand.zh: 有不同机器人平台上的代码接口复用与仿真到真机展示，但未验证夹爪与多指灵巧手之间的同任务迁移。单臂到双臂仍需调整控制接口，不代表任意末端零适配；未报告同任务跨手型配对评测。
cross_hand.en: Shared code interfaces support demonstrations across robots and sim-to-real, but no same-task transfer between grippers and multi-finger hands is validated. Single-to-bimanual deployment still changes control primitives; arbitrary effector deployment without adaptation and paired cross-hand evaluation are not established.

release.zh: 官方 MIT 仓库提供环境适配、评测配置、CaP-Agent0 和 GRPO 训练／部署说明。论文 v2 写 187 项，仓库 README 仍写 39 项并另列扩展任务说明，不能将二者等同为已完整验证的开放规模；部分仿真资产与感知模型需按上游条款获取。未核实独立示范数据集或后训练模型 checkpoint 下载入口；训练脚本会保存权重不等于作者已发布权重。
release.en: The official MIT repository provides environment adapters, evaluation configurations, Agent0 and GRPO training/deployment instructions. V2 reports 187 tasks while the README still lists 39 alongside extension guides, so full released coverage is not independently verified. Some assets/perception models require upstream access. Separate demonstration datasets and post-trained checkpoint downloads remain unverified; local checkpoint-saving instructions do not prove released weights.

highlight.zh: 通过工具抽象层级、单／多轮交互和视觉反馈的受控对照，区分 Coding Agent 能力与人工高级接口的帮助；再用视觉变化文字反馈、自动函数库和多候选代码综合构建免训练 CaP-Agent0，并以仿真奖励后训练代码生成模型。
highlight.en: Controlled comparisons of primitive abstraction, single/multi-turn interaction and visual grounding separate Coding Agent capability from designer scaffolding. Visual-change text, synthesized helpers and candidate-code synthesis form training-free Agent0; simulation rewards additionally post-train a code generator.

evaluation_scope.zh: 执行链为任务／观测→Python 代码→感知、运动规划／IK 与夹爪接口→执行反馈；底层控制器负责运动落地。CaP-Agent0 权重固定，复用从成功记录一次综合出的 9 个通用辅助函数，不是已实现持续技能进化。CaP-RL 则按任务以特权状态接口和 GRPO 更新 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 的代码生成参数，部署仍调用共享控制工具；不是训练关节级残差策略。真机拾块／叠块为 84%／76%，各 25 次，不能推广到所有任务或跨手能力。
evaluation_scope.en: The execution chain is task/observations → Python → perception, planning/IK and gripper APIs → feedback; controllers realize motions. Fixed-weight Agent0 reuses nine helpers synthesized once from successful traces, not demonstrated continual skill evolution. CaP-RL independently updates Qwen2.5-Coder-7B code generation per task with GRPO and privileged state APIs; deployed programs still call shared control tools, rather than a joint-level residual policy. Real lift/stack success is 84%/76% over 25 trials each, not an all-task or cross-hand result.
